title: General Elhami, Commander of the Army's Air Defense Force, made statements in Tehran in response to Trump's claim of destroying the Iranian Air Force.
text:
"General Elhami, Commander of the Army's Air Defense Force, made statements in Tehran in response to Trump's claim of destroying the Iranian Air Force."

""

"Brigadier General Alireza Elhami, Commander of the Army's Air Defense Force: "We prove in practice what we have and what we do. What you are witnessing today is the 100% and complete readiness of the air defense of the Islamic Republic of Iran. Both my dear brothers in the Army of the Islamic Republic of Iran and the air defense combatants of the IRGC are all 100% ready; we are conducting full and 100% monitoring across all borders.""

"Brigadier General Alireza Elhami, Commander of the Army's Air Defense Force: "It was just a few weeks ago that we publicized the downing of one of the strategic drones of the criminal US army, and everyone heard about it. If we had lost our assets, if we were not ready today to defend the country's airspace, then with what was the MQ-9 and all those strategic and expensive drones of our enemies, the enemy's strategic and effective fighters, shot down and destroyed?
